name: Haze Breath
description: Breathe a thin haze into a foe's face so that the foe loses the user's outline for a moment.

name: Palm Dew
description: Coat the palm with a cool film of dew that dulls a glancing blow.

name: Fog Slip
description: Slip a pace sideways through a patch of low mist as if sliding on wet cloth.

name: Clammy Palm
description: Strike with a palm heavy with cold mist so that the blow lands as a clammy shove.

name: Murk Cloak
description: Wear a cloak of grey murk that blurs the user's outline and turns weak blows.

name: Brume Sense
description: Feel through the mist the user has spread and learn the shapes that stand within it.

name: Ankle Fog
description: Spread a low thick fog round a foe's ankles so that the foe loses sure footing.

name: Fog Blur
description: Blur the air before the user so that a foe misjudges the distance by a hand.

name: Grey Slide
description: Slide two paces along the fog bank and arrive at the foe's flank.

name: Fog Jab
description: Drive a short jab out of the fog so that the foe sees the fist only as it lands.

name: Mist Shell
description: Close the fog into a close shell about the body that softens a blow.

name: Low Haar
description: Spread a low haar round an ally so that the ally's step falls quiet and the ally's outline fades.

name: Vapor Palm
description: Push a palm wrapped in warm vapor into a foe's chest and let the vapor sting the eyes.

name: Soft Catch
description: Catch a blow in a pocket of soft vapor that bleeds the force from it.

name: Hand Hide
description: Wrap the striking hand in vapor so that the foe cannot tell which hand will land.

name: Vapor Skip
description: Skip over a gap on a puff of vapor that bears the user's weight for one stride.

name: Wet Wrap
description: Wrap a foe's arm in damp vapor that clings and drags like wet cloth.

name: Steam Scent
description: Catch the warmth of living bodies in the vapor and trace where each one stands.

name: Vapor Guard
description: Hold a screen of dense vapor before the body to break the line of a thrown strike.

name: Skin Dew
description: Bead dew over the skin so that grips and blows slip off.

name: Haze Ring
description: Spread a ring of haze at arm's length that spoils the aim of anyone who strikes through it.

name: Wet Slap
description: Slap with a hand slick with dew so that the blow stings and skids.

name: Dewfall Step
description: Step on a film of dew so that the foot slides a long stride without effort.

name: Mist Shade
description: Throw up a shade of mist that sends a thrown missile off to one side.

name: Dew Feel
description: Read the beads of dew on the ground and learn who walked there and how lately.

name: Edge Soften
description: Soften the edges of the user's outline until a foe's eye cannot settle on it.

name: Grey Fade
description: Fade the user's colour to grey so that the user is hard to see at a short distance.

name: Hush Walk
description: Walk in a hush of mist that swallows the sound of each step.

name: Blur Guard
description: Blur the body's place so that a blow lands a finger's width from where it was aimed.

name: Fade Strike
description: Strike from the fade so that the foe cannot place the blow until it lands.

name: Pale Scan
description: Pass a pale thin mist across a room and note where it parts around the living.

name: Cloud Glide
description: Drift forward in the slow rolling manner of a bank of mist and cover ground without noise.

name: Wisp Turn
description: Turn on the spot like a wisp caught in a breeze and leave a foe's reach.

name: Mist Lean
description: Lean into the mist so that a straight blow passes through the place the body was.

name: Slow Cloud
description: Send a slow cloud across a foe's path so that the foe breaks stride and loses timing.

name: Drift Cut
description: Drift in close and cut across the foe's guard with the edge of a mist-wet hand.

name: Drift Shroud
description: Spread the drifting mist over an ally so that the ally moves unseen alongside the user.

name: Gauze Guard
description: Hang a gauze of mist in front of the body so that sharp edges lose their bite.
